faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Defender 200Tdi use?
faqLeft.a: The Defender 200Tdi uses the 200Tdi — a 2.5-litre inline-four diesel with mechanical injection. It was fitted to classic 90/110/130 models from approximately 1990 to 1994, before being replaced by the 300Tdi.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Defender 200Tdi engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £1,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Defender 200Tdi?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm you have the 200Tdi and provide an exact rebuild price.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Defender 200Tdi engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Defender if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Defender 200Tdi engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Defender 200Tdi owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
